root_cause.text: The `bpf_xdp_store_bytes` helper incorrectly declared its source (third) argument as `ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM` (which implies write permissions) instead of read-only memory, causing the BPF verifier to reject legitimate uses where the source pointer points to a read-only map and potentially allowing reads from uninitialized memory.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states the third argument type was `ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM`, which includes the MEM_WRITE flag. This caused the verifier to check for BPF_WRITE access on the pointer (a read-only map pointer), resulting in a "write into map forbidden" error. The patch changes it to `ARG_PTR_TO_MEM | MEM_RDONLY`, matching `bpf_skb_store_bytes`.
